svg.title: Installer downloads
svg.desc: Downloads, not users. An older release is closed as soon as a newer regular release is published: historical values distribute each release's baseline counter uniformly across the time it was the latest release, and observed increments count only the release that is current at each snapshot (with frequent releases, each bar mainly reflects uptake while a release is current). SUMMARY.md reports the raw counters across all releases, so the chart total and the SUMMARY.md total differ by design. Increments approximate UTC days; GitHub does not supply download timestamps. Gaps are shared evenly. Bots and retries are included.
svg.text: Daily downloads of the then-current release · UTC
